question: Should this Signal-local retry PR remain a candidate after the author adds live Signal proof and refreshes it on current main, or should maintainers consolidate on the broader session recovery path at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: The patch shape is plausible and source-supported, but it changes a live message-delivery path, lacks real Signal proof, is dirty against current main, and overlaps a proof-positive broader recovery PR that may be the better canonical fix.

options.title: Require Signal Proof And Refresh
options.body: Keep this PR open as a candidate only after redacted Signal/gateway proof is added and the branch is refreshed without dropping current batched reply metadata.

options.title: Consolidate On Core Recovery
options.body: If maintainers choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the canonical fix for this Signal issue, close this Signal-local branch after that replacement is accepted as covering the channel symptom.

options.title: Accept Unit-Only Risk
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly accept the mocked handler test evidence, but they would own the unproven live Signal delivery behavior and duplicate-candidate risk.

recommendation.title: Require Signal Proof And Refresh
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open as a candidate only after redacted Signal/gateway proof is added and the branch is refreshed without dropping current batched reply metadata.
